dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Elon, I truly respect you from the bottom of my heart. I also hold a large amount of Dogecoin. However, it keeps dropping, and I feel really sad. I hope you can somehow use your power to make it rise!
@elonmusk please.Dogefather!! Take care of Dogecoin too.

@elonmusk Please help me, Elon! I want to have a child in Japan, where the population is aging and declining, but I don’t have enough money. I bought Dogecoin, but it only keeps going down. If you tweet “DOGEcoin,” I might be able to have a child.
